pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches exhibiting high edge angularity with frequent jagged, dendritic protrusions into the inter-patch spaces. Patch area is significantly larger on the cervical region compared to the thoracic and flank regions where fragmentation increases.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored negative-space pathways characterized by frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes. Path thickness is relatively narrow, maintaining a consistent pixel width of roughly 5-10% of the adjacent patch diameter, creating a dense topological mesh.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the superior cervical-dorsal line displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency silhouette with fine-grained vertical pixel orientations.
